intro: Mint confirmed! Biggest signing in club history! The medical was you zooming in on a jpeg.
Years in an empty booth, and finally a player walks out. In slippers.
Welcome to the broadcast! Your whole life, live, with slow motion replays. Even the yawns.
ring: Pick up, ser! The bedside table is going WILD!
The crowd is chanting your name. It's me.
It's ringing! Will they pick up? I can't look!
wake: AND THEY'RE UP! One eye open. The other is appealing the decision.
LFG! {event} at {when}. Every pundit has you winning, and I'm every pundit.
Answered on ring two! Ring three is in the tunnel, crying.
Vertical! A new ATH! Previous record: horizontal.
What a save by the thumb! The legs remain bearish.
Game day, {event} at {when}! Face painted in your colours. Duvet grey.
{Name}gm! You're up! Lap of honour, straight to the kettle!
WE ARE LIVE! Sold out crowd! Attendance: me and a lamp.
snooze: Shock result! The pillow wins at home again.
Alarm subbed off after four seconds! Worst debut I've ever seen.
Nine minutes of dead air. Over to the weather: heavy duvet expected.
Launch delayed nine minutes! Still earlier than any roadmap.
Our star takes a knee. Then both knees. Then the duvet.
Straight back under! And the crowd goes mild.
voicemail: Live from your voicemail! Empty arena, but the echo is incredible. Incredible.
Call me back, champ! {event} at {when}. I've made a wagmi banner, spelled wrong.
Phone down the back of the sofa again? That sofa remains unbeaten.
No answer, and I refuse to panic. Not paper hands. Just very, very shaky.
You missed my team talk, so your coat got it. {event} at {when}. The coat is ready.
Hype man here with a FULL VOLUME LFG. Apologies to your neighbours.
absence: THEY'RE BACK! Greatest comeback in history! You went to the shops.
You were gone for hours, so I commentated the fridge. Strong fridge. Bit cold.
Hours away! I held a minute's silence for you. It lasted three hours.
I watched the floor the whole time you were out. Great news, the carpet's stable.
owner: Verified on-chain! I'm a one club Chog now, and the club is you.
You held through every red candle. I'd run through a wall for you. A small wall.
My owner's fixture! {event} at {when}. Your name's on my shirt, in pen.
stranger: Visitor in the away end! You can watch, but you can't sing the songs.
Away fan, welcome! The hype is free, but the chants are allowlist only.
You're not my player, but fine. {event} at {when}? One LFG, on loan.
recall: Stat check: you've snoozed {snoozes}. The snooze button is our top scorer.
{skipped}: no show! I told the fans two weeks. They booed.
You told me {fact}. Pure alpha. I've kept it secret, which is hard at this volume.
That's {streak} unbeaten! Up only! I've lost my voice and I don't want it back.
{attended}: you turned up! On-chain hall of fame. The hall is a shoebox.
now: We're live! This is the quiet part, so I'm whispering. I'm whispering SO hard.
Kickoff, {event} has started! I can't watch. I'm watching.
calendarFree: Nothing booked on {day}! Free agent, and the sofa has made an offer.
{day} is empty! That's not a gap in the diary, that's an airdrop.

dawn: Up before the birds! The birds have FOMO.
Dawn training! Just you and a fox. The fox looks sharper.
SO early. Few understand. The few are bakers.
gm! Nobody else is up, so I'm hyping the streetlights. They're doing great.
morning: The toast fell butter side UP. Today is up only.
gm! Coffee one is down, and coffee two is warming up on the bench.
What a sprint for the bus! Pure pace! Wrong bus.
Matching socks, first try, unbelievable scenes! Oh no. One's navy.
day: Halftime! The pros eat orange slices. You're eating crisps over the sink.
Afternoon slump! The eyelids are bearish. The biscuit is our only support.
You stood up! Huge green candle! Oh, and straight back down.
Mid afternoon, still in the game! Number go up! The number is unread emails.
dusk: Final whistle on the workday! Laptop shut! And the ref adds ten minutes of emails.
Post match interview, fren! Any regrets? Apart from the fourth coffee.
Golden hour! Everyone looks like a champion in this light. Even you.
Sundown, where heroes are made. Or pasta. Usually pasta.
night: Extra time! The crowd's gone home, and only one chant is left. Bed, bed, bed.
It's late, so it's whisper commentary. Lying down now. Gorgeous technique.
Another hour on the timeline this late! Incredible stamina, terrible idea.
gn! Lights off, eyes shut, phone down. Currently one out of three.

monday: New week, fresh roadmap, zero losses! Give it until lunch.
tuesday: Tuesdays are the week's unsung midfielder. All the work, no songs. So I wrote one: TUESDAY!
wednesday: The weekend is three days away! Actual days, not two weeks.
thursday: Thursday, semi final of the week! I've already ironed my scarf.
friday: Cup final of the week, and we've already won! Open top bus parade, straight to the sofa.
saturday: No work, a whole free day, limitless potential! Probably nothing.
sunday: Sunday, rest day! Doctor's orders. I'm not a doctor, but I am very loud.

clear: Clear skies, perfect conditions to touch grass! What a first touch that'll be.
cloud: Overcast and bearish! Perfect for a dramatic walk to the kettle.
rain: We play through this! Hood up, chin up, phone in a sandwich bag.
snow: The pitch is white, the match is off, and the snowman starts in goal.
fog: I can't see the pitch, so I'm commentating by sound. That sounds like a bin.
wind: Huge crosswind! Your umbrella is now playing for the other team.
hot: Scorcher! An ATH for the thermometer, and for your armpits.
cold: The only warm up today is you, hugging the radiator.

ahead: One hour, one agenda point, zero shots on target. A classic nil nil.
Talking fixture today! First one to say great question wins the golden boot.
Cameras on! {event} at {when}. I want you unmuted and dangerous.
soon: Mic check! Camera on, mute ready, toast out of shot.
Game plan! {event} is {soon}! Say one alpha thing early, then nod until the final whistle.
peek: Stay muted. Unmute once, to ask wen lunch.

ahead: Big one today, the final! I've cleared space in the trophy cabinet. It's a drawer.
Walk in today with a rare trait nobody else has. Ironed sleeves.
Title fight! {event} at {when}. I'm in your corner with a towel and no training.
soon: Deep breath! This is the moment! I'm so nervous I've chewed through my headset.
Shoulders back, {event} is {soon}! You're going to mainnet. In a clean shirt.
peek: Title decider. I slept in my kit.

ahead: Focus block today! This is golf, not football, so I'll whisper from behind a tree.
One uninterrupted hour would be a new ATH. The old record is eleven minutes.
Phone face down! {event} from {when}. The timeline has never won a medal.
soon: Closed training session! No press allowed. I'm the press, so I'm leaving.
Close every tab, {event} is {soon}! Especially the one with the floor price.
peek: The charts are benched, and the group chat is furious.

Check up today! They'll ask how you sleep. Do not say degen hours.
Physio on standby! {event} at {when}. I'm pacing like it's penalties.
soon: Brave face on, fren! I'll be right here, being quiet. A career first.
Stay calm, {event} is {soon}! Walk out like it's the tunnel. Nod to the fish tank.

ahead: Cue the training montage! Heavy bag, big sprint, four minutes looking for your water bottle.
Today the gains start vesting. First unlock: tomorrow, on the stairs.
Stopwatch ready! Airhorn ready! {event} at {when}, and your knees are not ready.
soon: Lace up! Your first rep will look like every champion's first rep. Confused.
Warm up, {event} is {soon}! Big stretch, bigger stretch. Oh, that's a yawn.
peek: Wen gains? The devs say two weeks.

ahead: Big feed today! Starter, main and dessert. Going for the treble!
Eating out today! Order with conviction. Food envy is paper hands.
Napkin on! {event} at {when}. Every sauce spill goes on-chain.
soon: Pre match meal! Carbs are the alpha. The side salad is a decoy.
Fork ready, {event} is {soon}! Somebody at that table WILL fumble the soup.
peek: Bread basket incoming. Ape in before anyone sees a menu.

At parties, assists count double. Set up the jokes, pass the dip.
Doors open! {event} at {when}. Big entrance, big night, big apology in the group chat.
soon: Kit check! Phone charged, keys found, best story warming up. Not the printer one.
Headline act, {event} is {soon}! Water between rounds. Wagmi, but hydrated.

Hug the original holders today. They minted you. No refunds.
Derby day! {event} at {when}! First tackle: you look tired.

No hype, no roadmap, no rugs. Errands are the most honest project in town.
I'm calling this one live! {event} at {when}. Few understand, fewer care.

Passport, tickets, charger! One of these is still on the bed.
Road trip! {event} at {when}. Your squad is you and a suitcase that won't zip.

Away day! {event} is {soon}! Bag in one hand, ticket in the other, sandwich in your mouth.

You're staked to the sofa today. No unstaking until dinner.

soon: Phone on silent! Anything that happens while you rest was probably nothing.

Stealth drop today! No details at all. Massively bullish.

any: Head contact! I'm going down! Three rolls and a scream!
Head poke! Three replay angles, all finger. That's my new pfp.
A tap on the head! Snapshot taken. You're on the allowlist for hugs.
beanie: Mind the beanie! Knitted in club colours. Wrong club.
Don't pull the knit! One loose thread and the beanie becomes a scarf.
cap: Hands off the lucky cap! Never washed. Pure concentrated luck, and smell.
The cap's backwards! That's degen mode. Or I dressed in the dark.
crown: Mind the crown! Won it in the genesis final. The other finalist fell asleep.
The crown! Biggest whale on this phone. Only whale on this phone.
horns: Bull by the horns! Very bullish of you. Also, ow.
Poke the horns and I charge! Armed only with compliments. You look great.
helmet: Knock on the helmet! Game day armour, built for big hits and comment sections.
Careful, ser! This helmet protects my only copy of the seed phrase.
hair: Not the hair! Rare trait! Was a rare trait.
Careful with the hairdo! You pressed it like a lift button.
band: The headband! Soaked in pure hopium. Please don't smell it.
Headband on means it's the final quarter. Or I couldn't find a brush.
hat: Watch the hat! Worn to every final, saw nothing, tall man in front.
One poke on the hat! Two more and it's the first real hat trick.
odd: That's the rarest headwear in the league. One of one. Slightly damp.
Is that even a hat? The league says no. The fans say utility.
none: Bare head poke! No hat, no helmet. Scalp doxxed.
No hat! Built for headers. I've never won a header.

any: Finger to the eye! I'm still playing! I can see colours I've never seen!
Face poke, no flinch! Unbelievable composure. Inside I'm screaming.
Face of the franchise! On the pfp, the banner, and now your fingerprint.
glasses: Mind the glasses! These are for DYOR. Today's research: your thumb.
Scouting report through the shades! Strengths, everything. Weaknesses, the snooze button.
sleepy: Gently with the eyes! Up all night rewatching your highlights. All four.
Half closed eyes! Saving my energy for your next green candle.
smiling: Eyes shut, grinning! Pure joy, folks! Or bracing for a rug!
Poke the happy face! Still smiling! This Chog has never seen a chart!
wide: Wide eyes! That's my face for a whale alert. Also for any sandwich.
Poke the big eyes and they get BIGGER! Number go up!
narrow: Game face! Scanning the crowd for whales. Found a seagull.
Squint face! Reviewing the replay frame by frame. Verdict: you have lovely fingers.

any: Shirt grab! Yellow card anywhere else. Here, it's affection.
You poked the kit! Signed by the whole squad. It's just me, in crayon.
Grab the shirt all you like. Nobody's ever got it off me. Nobody's tried.
suit: Careful with the suit! Awards night kit. Best commentator, voted by me.
Watch the lapels! This suit has seen three mainnet launches and one wedding buffet.
costume: That's the mascot outfit! Every great team has one. Ours is sweating.
Careful, the costume! Getting out of it has a vesting schedule.
hoodie: Mind the hoodie! Official degen uniform, worn to a final and to bed.
Hood up means I'm in the zone. The zone is quite chilly.
tee: Match day tee! My number's on the back. One of one.
Not the tee! It's a hopeful medium.
robe: Easy on the robe! Recovery kit: ice bath, interview, nap with the medal on.
Ring walk robe! Lights down, music up! Then I remember I'm the commentator.
jacket: Touchline jacket! For pacing, pointing, and yelling at a cone.
Inside pocket of this jacket? My cold wallet. It's a biscuit.
armor: Solid armour! It's survived every bear market. Your finger loses.
Gleaming armour, totally rekt proof! Is it stair proof? Unclear.
none: No kit! Shirt off celebration, and I haven't even scored.
Nothing to grab! Just the jpeg. Ref, that's a foul on a naked man.
